# Vendored header-only dependencies

- `httplib.h`: cpp-httplib 0.18.3 (MIT), upstream https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib.
- `json.hpp`: nlohmann/json 3.11.3 single include (MIT), upstream https://github.com/nlohmann/json.

These are direct upstream release files, not copied from the read-only reference project. License texts are included beside the headers. This project disables TLS in cpp-httplib and binds the API to loopback for local demonstrations.
